institution: IIIT Agartala (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Agartala)
data_source: Careers360 community Q&A and limited student reviews (aggregated public data)
sample_size_caveat: Formal Careers360 review data for IIIT Agartala specifically is limited; this analysis draws significantly on community Q&A discussions comparing it to peer institutes. Confidence is lower than for institutes with larger dedicated review samples.

key_positive_themes.notes: IIIT Agartala functions inside the campus of its mentor institute, NIT Agartala, benefiting from an established institution's mature facilities rather than struggling as a standalone new entity.

Hostel facilities described as very good and hygienic, with 24-hour water and electricity; campus offers access to a bank, library, dispensary, sports complex, canteen, and wifi, set in a green, scenic location.
Faculty described as highly competent, experienced, and benevolent, with strong industrial knowledge in their respective fields.

In several comparative community rankings, IIIT Agartala is cited among the stronger-placement newer IIITs, alongside IIIT Kalyani and IIIT Dharwad; one source cites 60% placement rate in 2018 with a highest package of 20 LPA.
In a direct comparison, IIIT Agartala's infrastructure and facilities were considered better than IIIT Manipur's, despite both being similarly new institutes.

key_negative_themes.notes: Established only in 2018, with the first batch graduating around 2022; this makes long-term placement and reputation data still relatively limited.
Early data shows an average package of around 4 LPA, on the lower side compared to top-performing IIITs, even though the highest package (20 LPA) was competitive.
As a newly established institute, IIIT Agartala does not yet have its own independent permanent campus, continuing to operate within NIT Agartala's premises.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: IIIT Agartala is very recent, established in 2018; faculty highly competent and experienced; campus life pretty good with bank, library, dispensary, sports complex, canteen, wifi
IIIT Agartala has a good rating of 3.9/5; infrastructure pretty good and one of the best in Agartala; faculty highly experienced and helpful; top companies visit with great packages
Comparing IIIT Agartala and IIIT Manipur — both new colleges with similar placements, but IIIT Agartala's infrastructure and facilities are better
Almost 60% of students got placed in 2018; highest package 20 LPA, average package 4 LPA

conclusion: Sentiment toward IIIT Agartala is positive, standing out among newer-generation IIITs due to its strong mentor-institute relationship with NIT Agartala, which provides access to established, well-rounded campus facilities. Faculty quality and early placement performance are viewed favorably relative to peer institutes, though as a young institute (established 2018), it is still building out its independent identity and longer-term placement track record.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a limited sample of publicly available community Q&A discussions and reviews (Careers360) as of the search date, since dedicated formal review data for this institute was sparse. Results are illustrative only and not a scientifically robust sentiment study.
